description: This PHP class defines a database migration script for the Revive Adserver, specifically handling schema changes related to variables, banners, campaigns, and trackers. It includes methods for pre- and post-operations around altering and removing database fields.

classes.name: Migration_334
classes.description: A PHP class extending Migration, implementing specific database schema changes for a particular version upgrade.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the migration with a list of tasks to perform before and after altering/removing specific database fields.

methods.name: beforeAlterField__variables__trackerid
methods.description: Pre-operation hook for altering the 'trackerid' field in 'variables' table.

methods.name: afterAlterField__variables__trackerid
methods.description: Post-operation hook for altering the 'trackerid' field in 'variables' table.

methods.description: Pre-operation hook for altering the 'datatype' field in 'variables' table.

methods.name: afterAlterField__variables__datatype
methods.description: Post-operation hook that updates 'datatype' to 'numeric' where it is empty, after altering the 'datatype' field.
